question: It is given that the numbers \(a\ge0,b\ge0,c\ge0\) are such that \(a+b+c=4\) and \((a+b)(b+c)(c+a)=24\). Then only one of the following statements is correct. Which one is it?

options.A: More information is needed to determine the values of \(a,b,c\).
options.B: Even when \(a\) is given to be 1, more information is needed to determine the values of \(b,c\).
options.D: There exist values of \(a\) and \(b\) from which the value of \(c\) could be determined.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
